_comment: OStim NG's English for the MCM texts 4Stim mirrors (data/Interface/translations/OStim_ENGLISH.txt, github.com/VersuchDrei/OStimNG, GPL-3.0), by key without "$ostim_". tools/make-mcm.py writes them as "$4stim_<key>", with "OStim" changed to "4Stim" and the overrides in make-mcm.py where 4Stim works differently.
use_auto_mode_solo: Use auto mode in solo scenes
use_auto_mode_fades: Fade out in between animation transitions
freecam: Switch to free cam mode on start
force_first: Force return to first person after scene
orgasm_end_male: End scene after male actor orgasm
orgasm_end_female: End scene after female actor orgasm
orgasm_end_all: End scene after all actors orgasmed
tooltip_reset_position: After the scene ends reset actors to where the where when the scene started.
tooltip_fades: Fade the screen to black when a scene starts/ends.
tooltip_use_intro_scenes: Use designated intro scenes when no specific scene was given. If disabled, any idle may be chosen.
tooltip_male_light_mode: Sets the light for male actors.
tooltip_female_light_mode: Sets the light for female actors.
tooltip_dark_light: Only use actor lights when the scene takes place in a dark area.
tooltip_export: Click this button to export the OStim MCM settings.
tooltip_import: Click this button to import the OStim MCM settings.
tooltip_main_key: Press while looking at an actor to start a duo scene. Hold while not looking at an actor to start a solo scene.
tooltip_npc_start_key: Press while looking at an actor to start an NPC scene with that actor, not involving the PC.
tooltip_speed_up_key: Increase speed during OStim scene.\nThe default key (numpad +) conflicts with many mods, may need to remap.
tooltip_speed_down_key: Decrease speed during OStim scene.\nThe default key (numpad -) conflicts with many mods, may need to remap.
tooltip_pullout_key: Only usable in manual mode.\nWhen pressed during a sexual animation, causes your actor to immediately cancel and \"pull out\" of the current animation.\nIn the alignment menu this changes the increase/decrease step.
tooltip_control_toggle_key: Press during an animation: switch between manual and full-auto control for the duration of that animation.\n Press outside of animation: switch between manual and full-auto control permanently.
tooltip_tfc_key: Toggle FreeCam during scenes involving the player.\n If using Improved Camera, make sure Clipping-less First Person is enabled when using this.
tooltip_key_alignment_menu: Opens the alignment menu. Changes made in the alignment menu will only be saved when it gets closed again. So if you Alt+F4 the game while the menu is still open your changes will be lost.
tooltip_key_hide_ui: Hides the UI until the key is pressed again.
tooltip_rumble: Rumble a controller on thrust, if a controller is being used.
tooltip_osa_up: Key used to go to up in OStim menus.
tooltip_osa_down: Key used to go to down in OStim menus.
tooltip_osa_left: Key used to go to left in OStim menus.\nIn the alignment menu this key decreases the current value.
tooltip_osa_right: Key used to go to right in OStim menus.\nIn the alignment menu this key increases the current value.
tooltip_osa_tog: Currently only used in the alignment menu.\nIn the alignment menu this key changes actors.
tooltip_osa_yes: Key used to activate the currently selected option in OStim menus.
tooltip_osa_end: Key used to end OStim scenes.
tooltip_auto_speed_control: Automatically increases speed in player scenes as the actors in a scene also raise their Excitement.\nThis feature is always enabled in NPC scenes.
tooltip_auto_speed_control_interval_min: Minimum amount of time before actors attempt to increase the speed.
tooltip_auto_speed_control_interval_max: Maximum amount of time before actors attempt to increase the speed.
tooltip_auto_speed_control_excitement_mi: Actors will not attempt to increase speed while all actors excitement is less than the minimum.
tooltip_auto_speed_control_excitement_ma: Actors will always increase speed while one actors excitement is more than the maximum.
tooltip_npc_scene_duration: Maximum duration for an NPC scene if it doesn't stop by end conditions before.
tooltip_end_npc_scene_on_orgasm: Despite all other orgasm settings end an NPC scene when one of the actors orgasms.
tooltip_navigation_distance_max: If the target scene of an animation change is only this many transitions away the scene will navigate there instead of warping.
tooltip_use_auto_mode_always: If enabled, scenes will play out on their own without user input via procedural generation.\nNote: If you have only used Manual mode briefly or not at all, and never became adept with using it, I STRONGLY recommend you give manual mode a fair chance before using this.
tooltip_use_auto_mode_solo: Always starts solo scenes in automatic mode.
tooltip_auto_mode_limit_to_navigation_di: Only choose new animations that are within the navigation distance. This will cause auto mode to always navigate to new animations rather than warping there.
tooltip_use_auto_mode_fades: Fade to black in between animation changes. Will only fade if the new animation is further away then the navigation distance.
tooltip_auto_mode_anim_duration_min: Minimum time before automatic mode changes to a new animation.
tooltip_auto_mode_anim_duration_max: Maximum time before automatic mode changes to a new animation.
tooltip_auto_mode_foreplay_chance: Likelihood for automatic mode to start with foreplay animations.
tooltip_auto_mode_foreplay_treshold_min: Minimum excitement an actor needs to reach before automatic mode stops foreplay animations.
tooltip_auto_mode_foreplay_treshold_max: Maximum excitement an actor needs to reach before automatic mode stops foreplay animations.
tooltip_auto_mode_pullout_chance: Likelihood for automatic mode to finish with a pullout animation.
tooltip_auto_mode_pullout_treshold_min: Minimum excitement an actor needs to reach before automatic mode goes into pullout animations.
tooltip_auto_mode_pullout_treshold_max: Maximum excitement an actor needs to reach before automatic mode goes into pullout animations.
tooltip_auto_fc: Automatically switch to free cam when a scene starts.
tooltip_fov: Sets the field of view of the camera when in FreeCam mode.\nThis is incompatible with Improved Camera.
tooltip_fc_speed: Set the speed of the free cam.
tooltip_force_first: Return to first person after the scene ends.
tooltip_excitement_mult_male: Multiply all the pleasure/second received by male actors by this amount.\nThis effectively lets you choose how long you want sex to last.\n3.0 = 3 times shorter, 0.1 = 10 times longer.
tooltip_excitement_mult_female: Multiply all the pleasure/second received by female actors by this amount.\nThis effectively lets you choose how long you want sex to last.\n3.0 = 3 times shorter, 0.1 = 10 times longer.
tooltip_excitement_decay_rate: Amount of excitement an actor loses every second if nothing exciting is happening in the scene. Unaffected by excitement multipliers.
tooltip_excitement_decay_grace_period: Time delay before excitement decay starts after the actor stops partaking in exciting actions.
tooltip_post_orgasm_excitement: After an orgasm female actors will start at this much excitement instead of going down to 0.\nStacks up with multiple orgasms (after 2nd orgasm they start at twice this amount, etc.)
tooltip_post_orgasm_excitement_max: Maximum value the post orgasm excitement for female actors can stack up to.
tooltip_player_bar: Enable the on-screen excitement bar for the player character.
tooltip_npc_bar: Enable the on-screen excitement bars for NPCs.
tooltip_auto_hide_bar: Automatically hide the bars during sex when not interacting with the UI.
tooltip_gendered_colors: Change the color of the bars to match the gender of the actor.
tooltip_orgasm_end_player: End the OStim scene automatically when the player orgasms.
tooltip_orgasm_end_male: End the OStim scene automatically when a male actor orgasms.
tooltip_orgasm_end_female: End the OStim scene automatically when a female actor orgasms.
tooltip_orgasm_end_all: End the OStim scene automatically when all actors have orgasmed.
tooltip_slowmo_orgasms: Add in a few seconds of slow-motion right when the player orgasms.
tooltip_blur_orgasms: Add in a screen blur when the player orgasms.
tooltip_auto_climax_anims: Automatically play climax animations on orgasm when the scene has one.
tooltip_intended_sex_only: Actors will only use scenes which were intended for their gender.\nThis only has limited support for legacy OSA scenes.
tooltip_always_dom_straight: Forces the player to always take the Dom role during Straight scenes.\nIf neither are enabled default actor placement will take place, if both are enabled player will default to Dom.\nNote that individual mods can temporarily override this setting.
tooltip_always_sub_straight: Forces the player to always take the Sub role during Straight scenes.\nIf neither are enabled default actor placement will take place, if both are enabled player will default to Dom.\nNote that individual mods can temporarily override this setting.
tooltip_always_dom_gay: Forces the player to always take the Dom role during Gay scenes.\nIf neither are enabled default actor placement will take place, if both are enabled player will default to Dom.\nNote that individual mods can temporarily override this setting.
tooltip_always_sub_gay: Forces the player to always take the Sub role during Gay scenes.\nIf neither are enabled default actor placement will take place, if both are enabled player will default to Dom.\nNote that individual mods can temporarily override this setting.
tooltip_select_role_straight: Select the role of the player at the start of a straight scene.
tooltip_select_role_gay: Select the role of the player at the start of a gay scene.
tooltip_select_role_threesome: Select the role of the player at the start of a threesome (or more) scene.
tooltip_unequip_strap_on_if_not_needed: Automatically remove strap-ons from female actors when they stop performing penetrative actions.
tooltip_futa_use_male_role: Futanari actors will be able to use male animations in addition to female ones.
tooltip_futa_use_male_excitement: Excitement calculation for futanari actors will use the male excitement multiplier instead of the female one.
tooltip_futa_use_male_orgasm: Orgasm handling for futanari actors will use the male settings instead of the female ones.
tooltip_enable_furniture: OStim will use nearby furniture to start scenes on.
tooltip_select_furniture: A message box will pop up to ask which furniture you want to use. Only affects scenes without a designated furniture.
tooltip_furniture_search_dist: High values may increase animation start time.
tooltip_reset_clutter: Reset clutter objects when starting/ending furniture scenes.
tooltip_reset_clutter_radius: High values may cause short game freezes on scene start/end.
tooltip_always_undress: Actors will always get fully undressed as a scene starts.\nMods using this mod's API can force an undress to occur even if this isn't checked.
tooltip_undress_if_need: Actors will get fully undressed as soon as a sexual animation plays.
tooltip_partial_undressing: Remove single armor pieces as the animations require it.
tooltip_animate_redress: Makes NPCs play redressing animations after a scene ends if they need to redress.
tooltip_undressing_about: Select which armor slots are stripped by OStim. See this if you don't know what that is: https://www.creationkit.com/index.php?title=Biped_Object\nThese settings apply to both the Player AND NPCs. Mouse over the names to see if you are wearing an armor piece in that slot. Green names are what Bethesda designated the slots for. Cyan names are what the community designated the slots for. Take the names with a grain of salt as many mods don't use the proper slots.
tooltip_expression_duration_min: Minimum time an expression lasts on an actors face.
tooltip_expression_duration_max: Maximum time an expression lasts on an actors face.
tooltip_moan_interval_min: Minimum time in between two moans of an actor.
tooltip_moan_interval_max: Maximum time in between two moans of an actor.
tooltip_moan_volume: Modifies the volume of moans. Does not affect talking.
tooltip_sound_volume: Modifies the volume of non vocal sounds. (e.g. the smack sound of spanking)
tooltip_scaling: Disables actor scaling. Warning: This will cause misalignment!
tooltip_schlong_bending: Disables schlong bending. Warning: This will cause misalignment!
tooltip_alignment_group_by_sex: Groups alignment by actor gender. Males and females will have different alignment settings.
tooltip_alignment_group_by_height: Groups alignment by actor height. Variations in heights will have different alignment settings.
tooltip_alignment_group_by_heels: Groups alignment by actor high heel offsets. Variations in high heel offsets will have different alignment settings.
tooltip_toy_slot_synchronization_type: Changes which actor in the scene the toy is synchronized with. If individual is selected for "all" you can define it per toy/slot.
tooltip_toy_slot_scaling_type: Changes how the toys power is calculated. If individual is selected for "all" you can define it per toy/slot.
tooltip_toy_slot_min_scale: Minimum scaling. When the selected scaling is below this value the minimum magnitude will be used. When it is above the magnitude will scale up to the max magnitude.
tooltip_toy_slot_max_scale: Maximum scaling. When the selected scaling is above this value the maximum magnitude will be used. When it is below the magnitude will scale down to the min magnitude.
tooltip_toy_slot_min_magnitude: Minimum magnitude for the toys power.
tooltip_toy_slot_max_magnitude: Maximum magnitude for the toys power.
tooltip_toy_slot_do_peaks: Enable magnitude peaks for this slot.
tooltip_toy_slot_do_climax: Activate this toy when the actor has a climax.
tooltip_unrestricted_navigation: If checked all requirement checks for all animations are skipped and you can play any animation with any combination of actors.\nNote: This can lead to some unexpected results in auto mode.
tooltip_no_facial_expressions: Disables all facial expressions during scenes. Warning: This will cause clipping during oral scenes! It is only intended to be used for screen-archery purposes.
